statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The purpose was to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The purpose was to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
The service is not separately payable under current policy guidelines
